Name: 10" Fat Boy Smoothing Blade
Description:
The Columbia Taping Tools 10" Fat Boy Smoothing Blade is designed for professional drywall finishers who demand excellent control, rigidity, and consistent results. Its innovative 2-piece composite construction creates a lightweight profile that remains extremely rigid, giving you the control and stability needed for precision drywall finishing.

The rubberized grip provides a comfortable, secure hold while helping maximize control during bedding, wiping down tape, finishing joints, and smoothing compound. The 7" size is ideal for detailed finishing work and tighter areas where precision matters.

Replaceable Blade Inserts

One of the biggest advantages of the Fat Boy Smoothing Blade system is its easily replaceable blade inserts. Instead of replacing the entire smoothing blade when the insert eventually wears, simply remove one of the end caps, slide out the worn insert, and slide in a new one.

This innovative design helps extend the life of your tool and significantly reduce replacement costs, allowing you to replace only the component that needs attention.

The Fat Boy Smoothing Blade family is available in sizes from 7" to 48", providing the right tool for virtually every stage of drywall finishing—from bedding and wiping down tape to finishing drywall joints and smoothing wider areas.

Key Features

  • 10" smoothing blade ideal for precision finishing and tighter areas
  • Innovative 2-piece composite construction
  • Lightweight yet extremely rigid profile
  • Rubberized grip provides comfort and enhanced control
  • Ideal for bedding and wiping down tape
  • Excellent for finishing drywall joints and smoothing compound
  • Replaceable blade inserts extend the life of the tool
  • Inserts can be replaced quickly by removing an end cap and sliding the insert in or out
  • Replace the insert instead of the entire blade for significant cost savings
  • Available in sizes from 7"–48" for a wide range of drywall finishing applications

This innovative design helps extend the life of your tool and significantly reduce replacement costs, allowing you to replace only the component that needs attention.

The Fat Boy Smoothing Blade family is available in sizes from 7" to 48", providing the right tool for virtually every stage of drywall finishing—from bedding and wiping down tape to finishing drywall joints and smoothing wider areas.

Name: 24" Fatboy Smoothing Blade

The rubberized grip provides a comfortable, secure hold while helping maximize control during bedding, wiping down tape, finishing joints, and smoothing compound.

One of the biggest advantages of the Fat Boy Smoothing Blade system is its easily replaceable blade inserts. Instead of replacing the entire smoothing blade when the insert eventually wears, simply remove one of the end caps, slide out the worn insert, and slide in a new one.

This innovative design helps extend the life of your tool and significantly reduce replacement costs, allowing you to replace only the component that needs attention.

The Fat Boy Smoothing Blade family is available in sizes from 7" to 48", providing the right tool for virtually every stage of drywall finishing—from bedding and wiping down tape to finishing drywall joints and smoothing wider areas.

Key Features

  • Lightweight yet extremely rigid profile
  • Rubberized grip provides comfort and enhanced control
  • Excellent for finishing drywall joints and smoothing compound
  • Replaceable blade inserts extend the life of the tool
  • Inserts can be replaced quickly by removing an end cap and sliding the insert in or out
  • Replace the insert instead of the entire blade for significant cost savings
  • Available in sizes from 7"–48" for a wide range of drywall finishing applications

Name: 32" Fat Boy Smoothing Blade
Description:
The Columbia Taping Tools 32" Fat Boy Smoothing Blade is designed for professional drywall finishers who demand excellent control, rigidity, and consistent results. Its innovative 2-piece composite construction creates a lightweight profile that remains extremely rigid, giving you the control and stability needed for precision drywall finishing.

The rubberized grip provides a comfortable, secure hold while helping maximize control during bedding, wiping down tape, finishing joints, and smoothing compound. 

Replaceable Blade Inserts

One of the biggest advantages of the Fat Boy Smoothing Blade system is its easily replaceable blade inserts. Instead of replacing the entire smoothing blade when the insert eventually wears, simply remove one of the end caps, slide out the worn insert, and slide in a new one.

This innovative design helps extend the life of your tool and significantly reduce replacement costs, allowing you to replace only the component that needs attention.

The Fat Boy Smoothing Blade family is available in sizes from 7" to 48", providing the right tool for virtually every stage of drywall finishing—from bedding and wiping down tape to finishing drywall joints and smoothing wider areas.

Key Features

  • 32" smoothing blade ideal for precision finishing
  • Innovative 2-piece composite construction
  • Lightweight yet extremely rigid profile
  • Rubberized grip provides comfort and enhanced control
  • Excellent for finishing drywall joints and smoothing compound
  • Replaceable blade inserts extend the life of the tool
  • Inserts can be replaced quickly by removing an end cap and sliding the insert in or out
  • Replace the insert instead of the entire blade for significant cost savings
  • Available in sizes from 7"–48" for a wide range of drywall finishing applications

Name: 40" Fat Boy Smoothing Blade
Description:
The Columbia Taping Tools 40" Fat Boy Smoothing Blade is designed for professional drywall finishers who demand excellent control, rigidity, and consistent results. Its innovative 2-piece composite construction creates a lightweight profile that remains extremely rigid, giving you the control and stability needed for precision drywall finishing.

The rubberized grip provides a comfortable, secure hold while helping maximize control during bedding, wiping down tape, finishing joints, and smoothing compound. 

Replaceable Blade Inserts

One of the biggest advantages of the Fat Boy Smoothing Blade system is its easily replaceable blade inserts. Instead of replacing the entire smoothing blade when the insert eventually wears, simply remove one of the end caps, slide out the worn insert, and slide in a new one.

This innovative design helps extend the life of your tool and significantly reduce replacement costs, allowing you to replace only the component that needs attention.

The Fat Boy Smoothing Blade family is available in sizes from 7" to 48", providing the right tool for virtually every stage of drywall finishing—from bedding and wiping down tape to finishing drywall joints and smoothing wider areas.

Key Features

  • 40" smoothing blade ideal for precision finishing
  • Innovative 2-piece composite construction
  • Lightweight yet extremely rigid profile
  • Rubberized grip provides comfort and enhanced control
  • Excellent for finishing drywall joints and smoothing compound
  • Replaceable blade inserts extend the life of the tool
  • Inserts can be replaced quickly by removing an end cap and sliding the insert in or out
  • Replace the insert instead of the entire blade for significant cost savings
  • Available in sizes from 7"–48" for a wide range of drywall finishing applications

Name: 40" Tomahawk Smoothing Blade

The Columbia Tomahawk set of Smoothing Blades is the most durable set on the market today. With no plastic pieces, the Tomahawk doesn’t snap under pressure. And because the blades use a Flat Box handle, there are no plastic adaptors that will break with the weight of the larger blades. This also increases the stability and your ability to adjust the angle of attack while in motion. The Columbia Tomahawk will change what the industry expects from a professional grade Smoothing Blade.

FEATURES:

  • 9 sizes: 7″, 10″, 12″, 14″, 18″, 24″, 32″, 40″ & 48″
  • Works with a Flat Box handle or use the CLTHA adaptor for the Columbia One handle
  • Interchangeable blades – keep the body, switch out blade when damaged or worn

Name: 7" Fat Boy Smoothing Blade
Description:
The Columbia Taping Tools 7" Fat Boy Smoothing Blade is designed for professional drywall finishers who demand excellent control, rigidity, and consistent results. Its innovative 2-piece composite construction creates a lightweight profile that remains extremely rigid, giving you the control and stability needed for precision drywall finishing.

The rubberized grip provides a comfortable, secure hold while helping maximize control during bedding, wiping down tape, finishing joints, and smoothing compound. The 7" size is ideal for detailed finishing work and tighter areas where precision matters.

Replaceable Blade Inserts

One of the biggest advantages of the Fat Boy Smoothing Blade system is its easily replaceable blade inserts. Instead of replacing the entire smoothing blade when the insert eventually wears, simply remove one of the end caps, slide out the worn insert, and slide in a new one.

This innovative design helps extend the life of your tool and significantly reduce replacement costs, allowing you to replace only the component that needs attention.

The Fat Boy Smoothing Blade family is available in sizes from 7" to 48", providing the right tool for virtually every stage of drywall finishing—from bedding and wiping down tape to finishing drywall joints and smoothing wider areas.

Key Features

  • 7" smoothing blade ideal for precision finishing and tighter areas
  • Innovative 2-piece composite construction
  • Lightweight yet extremely rigid profile
  • Rubberized grip provides comfort and enhanced control
  • Ideal for bedding and wiping down tape
  • Excellent for finishing drywall joints and smoothing compound
  • Replaceable blade inserts extend the life of the tool
  • Inserts can be replaced quickly by removing an end cap and sliding the insert in or out
  • Replace the insert instead of the entire blade for significant cost savings
  • Available in sizes from 7"–48" for a wide range of drywall finishing applications

The Columbia Taping Tools Drywall Sander Head is designed to help professional drywall finishers achieve smooth, consistent surfaces with greater control and efficiency. Designed for Efficient Drywall Sanding

Professional drywall finishing requires a smooth surface and the right amount of control. The Columbia Drywall Sander Head is designed to make the sanding process more efficient while helping finishers maintain consistent contact with the surface.

Use it for final sanding, smoothing joint compound, feathering edges, and preparing drywall surfaces for the next stage of finishing.

  • Durable Construction – Built to withstand the demands of professional drywall finishing.
  • Jobsite Ready – Suitable for professional contractors, drywall finishers, and renovation crews.
  • Easy to Use – Practical design makes sanding and surface preparation simple and efficient.
  • Columbia Quality – Designed as part of the Columbia Taping Tools professional drywall finishing system.

Get the Surface Ready for the Finish

The final sanding stage can make the difference between an average drywall job and a professional finish. The Columbia Drywall Sander Head provides the control and stability needed to smooth joint compound, blend edges, and prepare surfaces for primer and paint.

Sand smooth. Finish clean. Get professional results.

The Columbia Taping Tools Difference

Columbia Taping Tools develops professional drywall taping and finishing equipment designed for the demands of the trade. From taping and finishing to sanding and surface preparation, our tools are built to help contractors work efficiently and deliver consistent results.

The Columbia Drywall Sander Head is a dependable addition to any professional drywall finishing setup.

Professional design. Reliable performance. Built for drywall finishers.

Name: Fatboy Smoothing Blade Claw Handle Adaptor
Description:
The Columbia Taping Tools Fat Boy Smoothing Blade Claw Handle Adapter adds versatility to your Fat Boy Smoothing Blade by allowing it to connect to Columbia extendable fiberglass handles. Designed with a quick-release system and rigid composite construction, the Claw Handle Adapter makes it easy to change handle lengths and reach high walls and ceilings without sacrificing control or stability.

The quick-release Claw Handle Adapter allows for on-the-fly changes between different handle lengths, making it easy to adapt to changing jobsite conditions. Two quick-release tabs located on top of the Claw Handle Adapter allow you to quickly release the adapter from the composite smoothing blade housing when needed.

Constructed from a highly resilient, glass-filled composite, the Fat Boy Smoothing Blade Claw Handle Adapter is built for long-lasting durability while maintaining a lightweight, rigid connection between the smoothing blade and handle.

The Claw Handle Adapter is compatible with Columbia extension handles available in two sizes: 4'–6' and 5'–8'. Simply connect your Fat Boy Smoothing Blade to the Claw Handle Adapter and attach it to your preferred extension handle to gain the extra reach needed to efficiently finish high walls and ceilings.

Adding a handle can also help increase finishing speed while reducing the strain placed on your wrists and back, making the Fat Boy Smoothing Blade Claw Handle Adapter an excellent solution for larger finishing projects and extended periods of use.

  • Quick-release Claw Handle Adapter design
  • Allows fast changes between different smoothing blade lengths
  • Two quick-release tabs provide easy removal from the smoothing blade housing
  • Highly resilient glass-filled composite construction
  • Lightweight and extremely rigid

  • Provides additional reach for high walls and ceilings

Short when you need control. Long when you need reach.

Columbia Taping Tools designs professional drywall taping and finishing equipment around the real-world needs of contractors. The Twist Lock Handle combines an adjustable three-stage design with a simple twist-lock system to give professionals one versatile handle that can adapt to the job.

Whether you're working on standard-height walls or reaching toward an 8-foot extension, the Columbia Twist Lock Handle helps you work efficiently while reducing unnecessary climbing and repositioning.
